User: Hello, I've heard you don't like Napoleon Dynamite. What's your review on it?

Agent: When I first saw this movie advertised I was like, what the hell is that? Then my friend made me go see it with him and from the first second all the way through I was hysterical. You can't get enough of how unbelievably hilarious this guy's personality is. The tater tots were the best part in my opinion. If you are open-minded and want to see a brand new kind of humor, or at least to me, then definitely check this one out you will love it.
User: Thanks for the review. Can you recommend me a movie?

Agent: Sure, I recommend Holes VHS. It mixes up a Jew in Latvia cursed by a Roma fortune teller with an eccentric inventor failing his family with a female stagecoach & train robber with a treasure hunt with juvenile delinquents working off their sentences digging holes in a dry lake bed in Texas. Quite edgy for Disney.
